SELECT fished_date_doy, 
       COUNT(*) as trip_count, 
       SUM(yt) as total_yt,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN yt > 0 
           THEN yt::float / NULLIF(anglers + 1, 0) ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 3) as avg_share
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy >= 287 AND fished_date_doy <= 304
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy;

SELECT fished_date_doy, boat, cls,
       COUNT(*) as trips, 
       SUM(yt) as yt,
       ROUND(AVG(yt::float / NULLIF(anglers + 1, 0))::numeric, 3) as share_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy >= 287 AND fished_date_doy <= 297 AND cls = 'day_1_5'
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, boat, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, share_per_trip DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy, boat, cls, COUNT(*) as freq
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
  AND cls = 'day_1_5'
  AND avail_doy <= 182
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, boat, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, boat;

SELECT fished_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy >= 92 AND fished_date_doy <= 151
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY total_yt DESC
LIMIT 10;
